# GitHub README Standard

Use clean headings without emojis, a real live demo link, restrained badges, accurate capability status, architecture, workflow graphics, repository tree, installation and tested API examples, security and privacy, roadmap, deployment status, changelog and ownership.

Maintain animated SVG assets only when they improve explanation. Never fabricate videos, screenshots, testing results, partnerships or retailer accuracy. A README cannot execute live HTML; link to the deployed web application.

Every substantial edit requires updates to README, CHANGELOG, PROJECT_CONTEXT and dated project memory. Preserve repo spelling universal-fasion-size and owner Md Najmul Hossain.
